Our Parents love the opportunity to drop their children off at our safe and secure Dojos where they will be surrounded by learning opportunities while they have the opportunity to unwind however they see fit in after school coding activities! Our Dojos are also places for birthday parties! Celebrate your child's birthday in style and let them show off all they have learned to their friends!
